bends.note: Southern runs due E-W from Auburn to just east of Young, then angles ESE to the east edge

ends.note: north part of Young (45 ft, from Southern) stops at the lot line y~2000; the next ~680 px south are lots of block 2
south part of Young (50 ft) begins at block 2's slanted rear line; continues south across Bodman and Dorchester off the sheet
Earnshaw's north line turns north at x~2686 (183 coverage) and east of that the Mt Auburn school grounds and lots reach the top edge; the street is not drawn further east on this sheet

notes: Sheet is drawn north-up (unlike 172). Auburn Av (60 ft) runs N-S down the west side; its centreline drifts from x~603 at the top to ~635 at Dorchester. West of Auburn the blocks are 172/182 outlines: a block line at y~440 (x 235-498) west of Auburn near the top may be Guthrie (key map 'GUTHRIE (ERIE)', in line with Earnshaw), but nothing else is drawn there, so Auburn/Earnshaw is recorded as T; the west line of Auburn is interrupted by the compass rose at y~805-1060 (not a street). Earnshaw printed 'EARNSHAW AV. (SUPERIOR AV.)'. Bodman printed 'BODMANN AV.' on the street (lots, key map and sheets 172/174 say 'BODMAN', so recorded as Bodman Avenue); it continues east past Young off the drawn area. Estelle (printed 'ESTELLE ST.', 26 ft) and Huntington Pl ('HUNTINGTON PL.', ~49 ft) are stubs from the west (sheet 172). Auburn/Dorchester junction (matches sheet 172 rotated ~42 deg): Dorchester's west leg (40 ft, from 172; centre y~4121) and east leg (50 ft, centre y~4213) are offset ~92 px, so two T points on Auburn; Sycamore (from 172, unlabelled here) comes in from the WSW with its pipe curving into the junction (point taken from the 172 geometry); south of the junction a ~30 ft unlabelled street (x 642-742, 4" W.P.) continues south: named South Auburn Avenue from the key map ('S. AUBURN AV.'). Bigelow St (~53 ft) and Josephine St (~51 ft) run south from Dorchester off the sheet. Young (printed 'YOUNG') is in two pieces: 45 ft from Southern south to a dead end at y~2000, and 50 ft from a dead end at y~2692 south across Bodman and Dorchester off the sheet; both share the centreline x~3290. Southern printed '37'' (measures ~40 ft).
